title: Accelerating Volume Reconstruction with 3D Texture Hardware

PDF Accelerating Volume Reconstruction with 3D Texture Hardware
We have presented a volume rendering approach that leverages the 3D texturing hardware available on high-performance graphics systems. The texturing hardware accelerates the reconstruction and resampling process inherent in all volume visualization algorithms.
